title: TS-73 Host recycled mid-session during a 110 s turn, adding a host start
description: Live rehearsal: host generation 10 to 11 during one long turn, so a 3-start budget was exceeded (4). Find why a host exits or is replaced while a turn is in flight (idle timeout versus activity, lease relinquish TS-61). Scenario first.
right_now_summary: The team is tracing why the host was replaced during a long turn and exceeded the three-start budget.
